title: Manila to Baguio: Philippines Mountain Highway EV Drive
subtitle: A 3-day family road trip up the Cordillera Mountains to the Summer Capital

route.kidActivities: Aqua Planet Pampanga (largest water park in the Philippines)

route.charger: Cleanfuel Tarlac (departure), Baguio hotel overnight charger
route.kidActivities: Kennon Road mountain views, Baguio Country Club
Mines View Park, Burnham Park boating, Session Road shopping

bestFor: Filipino families wanting a cool mountain escape from Manila heat
tips: Cleanfuel chargers are the most reliable on the NLEX-SCTEX corridor
The mountain ascent to Baguio uses more battery — charge fully in Tarlac before climbing
Leave Manila before 6am to avoid traffic — return on a weekday if possible
seasonal: November to May (dry season, cooler in Baguio)
